Original missing-font substitution controls. Names are invented and unavailable. The reference application selects Calibri for explicit auto/swiss/modern/script/decorative families and Cambria for roman, including conflicting PANOSE, fixed pitch, and notTrueType controls. Changing the document theme does not change these native choices.

The implementation covers Latin family metadata (including omitted family defaulting to auto) with ordered primary, authored alternative and family fallback choices. Missing font-table entries remain unimplemented. Unavailable and self-referencing alternatives continue to the family fallback; all twelve native fallback rows now pass the exact family choice and 0.2pt position checks. Installed primary fonts and explicit alternatives retain priority; when the native fallback is unavailable, existing Noto fallback remains. No standalone font files or runtime assets are added. The native reference PDFs are original control-document references.
